Saves & progress

Progress in these builds is saved on your device. Removing the app during troubleshooting can erase your saves. First try reopening the app and checking that your device has enough free storage.

Purchases & refunds

For real store purchases, share your order number only. Check that you are signed in to the same store account used for the purchase. Start refund requests with the relevant store; do not send payment or card details.

Report an issue

Include your game version, device model, and the steps that lead to the issue. You can attach a screenshot. Contact us before removing the app so that troubleshooting can take your save data into account.

A little help

A question before you play?

Do I need an account?

No. Your progress, settings, and race history stay on your device, as do the player names entered for a race.

When will it be in stores?

A release date has not been announced. App Store and Google Play links will appear here when ready.

What to include in your message

  • The game name and version
  • Your device model and operating system
  • Steps that lead to the issue
  • A screenshot without personal information

Keep your details to yourself.

Never send passwords or card details. A store order number is enough for purchase support. Refunds are handled by the store where you made the purchase.
